capabilities: create Markdown notes from built-in templates
create DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files from bundled templates
edit JSON, YAML, CSV and code files with syntax validation
open vault files and user-picked device files
import copies of selected device files into the vault
extras: Free with voluntary Ko-fi funding that unlocks nothing. README states version 0.10.3 is a stable release manually tested and distributed via BRAT, while the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; parts of the current beta use a Spanish interface.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file handling is centered on Markdown, so creating Office or data files, opening non-Markdown vault files, and importing a device file have no unified launcher.

requires.name: Office-compatible software (Microsoft Office, WPS Office, LibreOffice) to open generated documents

summary: Visual hub for creating, organizing and opening Markdown notes, Office documents, data files, PDFs, media and web link cards from one place.
